text: The skim milk is pushed through a membrane that holds back the proteins, and the cream and the minerals that went through are put back, so the milk keeps its fat and gets denser in protein.

steps.name: return minerals
steps.note: The stream rich in lactose (milk sugar) is split again through finer membranes, and the minerals go back.
Lactase, an enzyme that breaks down milk sugar, is added for the lactose left over; it is on the label.
